corrections.reason: The printed glyph at the end of the line has the 6th-order side loop on ው (ውሀና ደም, 'water and blood'), not 1st-order ወ.
Classical Ge'ez singular noun እድ takes the 5th-order vowel before pronominal suffixes (በእዴሁ, 'in his hand'), and the 5th-order ring on ዴ is visible.
In the Ge'ez clause 'ዘበጦ ዝኩ መልአክ በሰይፉ ለመንጦላዕተ ምኵራብ', the final character on L01 is the preposition ለ- wrapping onto መንጦላዕተ on L02, slightly smudged at the base to resemble ሀ.
